First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Pace isn’t posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you’re new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.
Read
Gravel tires: tire pressure, tread, tubeless.

About the Babes on Bikes Weekly Ride group ride

Babes on Bikes Weekly Ride is a gravel group ride in Emporia, KS. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from 700 block of Commercial St, downtown Emporia.

A weekly women’s ride in the home town of Unbound Gravel. Visit Emporia points riders to the group’s Facebook page for updates. The visitor guide lists it on Wednesdays around 6 pm from the 700 block of Commercial Street. Confirm on Facebook before you show up.
